_note: Device params for the six-piece chain (nanodevice_prepare, nanodevice_topgate, _contacts, _electrodes, _pads, _fingers, _finalcheck). Copy to <device>/klayoutclaw/data/params.json. Local frame: x' across the bottom graphite, y' along it towards gate_end, origin at the bottom-graphite hull centroid.

back_gate._note: edge_contact: true when no bottom graphite is bare; back-gate leads then land on bottom graphite under the bottom hBN

args._note: Per-script defaults, keyed '<skill>/<script>' with argument names (n, tail_slots, ...); the command line still wins. Any argument of a script may go in its block. Check scripts read their writer's block. Effective arguments and choices are written to record.json next to this file.

prepare._note: nanodevice_prepare: paths relative to the device folder; see its SKILL.md
